enchantments.tooltip: Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +17 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Deadly +7: +7 Competence bonus to weapon damage.
Quality Bluff +4: Passive: +4 Quality bonus to the Bluff skill.
Freedom of Movement: This item grants its wearer the ability to move and attack normally while under the influence of magic that impedes movement, such as paralysis, solid fog, slow and web.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
